title: Set passage 9:58-60 and zakah calculation
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Summer 1: Sawm, Zakah and Khums, Hajj (3.3 to 3.5)
source: Written for islamic-studies/y10 lesson 27 (Pupil PDF worksheet: set passage 9:58-60 and zakah calculation)
intro: Lesson 27: 3.4 Zakah: nature and purpose (Qur'an 9:58-60). Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

questions.q: Amina has £10,000 savings held for a lunar year, above the nisab. How much zakah?
Hamza has £3,600 savings held for a year, above the nisab. How much zakah?

head: Question
Answer
rows: Adult Muslims whose wealth reaches the nisab
2.5% of savings, gold, silver, trade goods
After a lunar year (hawl) above the nisab
85 g of gold or 595 g of silver in value
Crops (10% or 5%) and livestock at set rates

passage.title: at-Tawbah 9:60
paras: Zakah expenditures are only for the poor and the needy, those employed to collect it, those whose hearts are to be reconciled, freeing captives, those in debt, in the cause of Allah, and the stranded traveller: an obligation from Allah.

panels.title: 9:58-59: the context
points: Some criticised how the Prophet ﷺ shared it
They were pleased only if they received
Allah says: be content with what Allah and His Messenger give

panels.title: Why zakah?
points: Meets the needs of the poor
From the rich to the poor (Bukhari and Muslim)

keywords.def: the obligatory charity, the third pillar
the minimum wealth on which zakah is due
one lunar year that wealth is held
the categories who may receive zakah

questions.q: Describe the nature of zakah. (4 marks, our own question)
questions.a: The third pillar; 2.5% of wealth above the nisab held for a lunar year; paid by adult Muslims; given to the eight groups of 9:60.

questions.q: Zakah is how much of savings?
Set passage task in the portal response box (6 marks, our own question): 'Explain what Qur'an 9:58-60 teaches about zakah.' Three developed points. Start: 'Firstly, 9:60 teaches that ...'
questions.a: Eight named recipients (9:60); an obligation from Allah, not a favour (9:60); criticism of those who judged the distribution by their own gain (9:58-59), each explained

questions.q: Extend: a worked example: Amina has £10,000 savings held for a year, above the nisab. How much zakah?
How many categories of recipient are named in 9:60?
questions.a: A) Eight. The poor, the needy, collectors, hearts reconciled, captives, debtors, the cause of Allah, travellers.
The minimum wealth on which zakah is due
options: The minimum wealth on which zakah is due

questions.q: Think again: how does giving purify and grow wealth?
questions.a: It cleans greed (9:103) and brings barakah; charity does not decrease wealth (Muslim)
